== Summary ==
"The Daily Wrap-Up" header of [[Francis Lalumiere|Francis K. Lalumiere]]'s DecipherCon 1999 reports. Graphic: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
